question: Identify candidate fusion gene junctions from RNA-Seq data. Align reads with STAR using chimeric detection parameters to produce a chimeric junction file, then extract candidate fusion junctions into a CSV.

expected_output.guidelines: Junction records must match the reference in donor and acceptor chromosome, position, and strand; read-level annotation columns may differ.
Fusion records must match the reference in chr1, base1, strand1, chr2, base2, strand2, and junction_type; row and column order may differ.
